title: 系统提示词的幻觉：指令前导如何改变语言模型中的计算
summary: 研究通过CKA分析17个指令微调模型发现，系统提示词对模型内部表征的影响具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性：人格与格式指令深度重构中间表征，而安全指令几乎不改变计算路径，安全渗透率在70B-72B模型上仍低于10%，从机制上解释了基于系统提示词的安全防护为何容易被越狱。
summary_en: Using CKA across 17 instruction-tuned models, this study shows system prompts modify transformer computation in a layer-selective, instruction-type-dependent way: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure representations, while safety instructions barely alter them, with safety penetration below 10% even at 70B-72B, mechanistically explaining persistent jailbreak vulnerability.
